facts.fact: 本章时间：舞会（Chapter One）之后的数日；Zane 对 Caroline Stanford Grey 产生了好奇
facts.anchor: The days following the ball, I grew curious about Caroline Stanford Grey.

facts.fact: Zane 只能从远处打听 Caroline，连股票行情都顾不上，全部心思都在调查她
facts.anchor: All I could do was learn about her from a distance, and the effort was currently taking up all the space in my brain.

facts.fact: Zane 雇了两名调查员，读他们的笔记后认定 Orson Grey 配不上 Caroline
facts.anchor: While I read the notes provided by my two investigators, one thing became abundantly clear: Orson Grey did not deserve this woman.

facts.fact: Caroline 与父亲 Stanford 都是东海岸最有名的古籍鉴定人；她婚前随父四处鉴书，甚至为一位巴伐利亚亲王鉴过书
facts.anchor: Before her marriage, Caroline had traveled extensively with her father on various jobs, even appraising books for a Bavarian prince before her debut.

facts.fact: Zane 判断 Orson 在限制妻子的独立，并把 Orson 的脑子比作一颗豌豆
facts.anchor: Was Grey curbing his wife’s independence? I wouldn’t doubt it.

facts.fact: Zane 脸上的疤来自十二年前那场他被冤枉的事故；此后他只能躲在阴影里
facts.anchor: Twelve years since the accident, one I was erroneously blamed for, yet it felt like yesterday.

facts.fact: 管家 Fletcher 大半生是私掠船船长，右眼在与海军当局的冲突中失去，因此戴着眼罩
facts.anchor: A privateer for most of his life, Fletcher wore a patch over his right eye, which had been lost during a skirmish with the naval authorities.

facts.fact: Zane 为自己被迫承办的那场舞会让厨房员工歇班好几天，Camilla 因此质问他
facts.anchor: I gave the kitchen staff a few days off after the ball you forced me to host.

facts.fact: Orson 在 Caroline 面前说 Zane 疯了、彻底不正常，并称他「生来一无所有、在自家工厂做过工」
Orson 立刻下令把 Caroline 的书搬到阁楼，作为准许她外出鉴书的「交换」
facts.anchor: I’ll instruct the footmen to take your collection of books to the attic.
